draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Sinhagad! The Lion's Fort, once called Kondhana, has seen many battles, the most famous being the Battle of Sinhagad in 1670. It's one of the highest points around Pune and a favourite weekend escape for Punekars.
draft.hungryLine: I don't have a named place to eat up here, so carry water and a snack, especially if you're doing the trek up.

moodReplies.show-me-around: You're right at the fort. Walk around the summit and take in the views, it's about 28 km southwest of Pune.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a quiet corner of the summit and enjoy being on one of the highest peaks around Pune.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Before it was the Lion's Fort, this place was called Kondhana.

spots.name: Sinhagad
spots.detail: Right here · The old Kondhana fort, scene of the 1670 Battle of Sinhagad

tips.title: Come on a weekday if you can.
tips.body: Sinhagad is a popular weekend outing for people from Pune, so weekdays are calmer.

tips.title: Pick your way up.
tips.body: Trek 2.7 km one way from the base with about 600 m of climbing, or take the road or a shared taxi to the summit.

story.title: Kondhana
story.body: This ancient hill fortress was first known as Kondhana. It sits about 28 km southwest of Pune.

story.title: The Battle of Sinhagad
story.body: The fort saw many battles, but the best known is the Battle of Sinhagad in 1670. Today it's known as the Lion's Fort.

story.title: Pune's weekend trek
story.body: A road now runs straight to the summit, and shared taxis go to the base and the top. Plenty of hikers still prefer the 2.7 km climb.
